newsitem.title: JAPAN: DDI seen posting group net profit in 97/98--paper.
newsitem.headline: DDI seen posting group net profit in 97/98--paper.

text.p: DDI Corp is expected to post a group net profit of at least 20 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, against the firm's forecast of a group net loss of 26 billion yen last business year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported at the weekend.
The business daily said it expected the company's parent net profit in 1997/98 to fall to 30 billion yen from DDI's estimate of 36.50 billion yen for 1996/97.
DDI offers domestic long-distance telephone services.
The paper said the expected rise in DDI's group net profit in 1997/98 was because excessive discounts in personal handy phone system (PHS) telephones were ending.
The paper said that the forecast fall in DDI's parent net profit in 1997/98 would be due to an expected fall in sales because of DDI's cut in its phone charges.
DDI was not immediately available for comment on the report.
